description: Approve a post awaiting team approval. Requires a role with post:approve (owner, admin, approver). Releases a post with approvalStatus 'pending': it publishes at its scheduled time, or immediately if that time passed less than 15 minutes ago. If the scheduled time passed more than 15 minutes ago, whenLate decides: 'publish' publishes it immediately (status 'publishing'); 'hold' approves it but returns it with status 'draft' (approvalStatus 'approved', scheduledAt unchanged) and the author is notified to choose a new time — tell the user it needs rescheduling. When whenLate is omitted it follows the post's publishWhenApproved: true means 'publish', false means 'hold'. If a late post's publishWhenApproved is false, ask the user whether to publish now or send it back before approving. The author is notified in-app either way. Approving sets publishWhenApproved to false. Pass the updatedAt of the version you showed the user as ifUnmodifiedSince, so an edit made since then is not approved unseen. Errors: 400 if the post is not awaiting approval, whenLate is not 'publish'/'hold' or ifUnmodifiedSince is not a timestamp, 403 if the role lacks post:approve, 404 if not found, 409 if the post changed since you loaded it (checked when ifUnmodifiedSince is sent) or is no longer awaiting approval — reload it with get_post and review again. Use this when the user (an owner/admin/approver) wants to approve a post awaiting team approval.

ifUnmodifiedSince.description: Optional. The post's updatedAt (ISO 8601) as you last loaded it with get_post. The approval only lands on that version; if the post changed since, nothing is written and the call returns 409.

whenLate.description: Optional. Only matters when the post's scheduled time passed more than 15 minutes ago: 'publish' = publish now, 'hold' = approve and return it to draft for the author to pick a new time. Defaults to 'publish' when the post's publishWhenApproved is true, otherwise 'hold'.

name: approve_post

approvalStatus.description: Team approval state: none, pending, approved or rejected.

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time the post was created.

id.description: The post's ID, used by get_post, update_post, publish_post and delete_post.

mediaFiles.description: Media on the post itself: file IDs after create_post or update_post, full file objects from get_post and list_posts.

postPlatforms.description: One entry per destination, with its platform and its own publish status.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the post was published.

recurringSchedule.description: get_post and list_posts: the repeat schedule the post belongs to, or null.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 time the post is scheduled for.

status.description: draft, scheduled, publishing, processing, published, partial or failed.

threadMediaFiles.description: get_post and list_posts: the media the thread parts reference. Not included in mediaFiles.

threadParts.description: For a thread post: its parts, in order.

timezone.description: Time zone the schedule was set in.

title: Approve pending post
